Events A and B are independent. P(A) = 0.3 and P(B) = 0.5. P(A ∪ B) =:
questions.explanation: P(A∪B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(A∩B). For independent events: P(A∩B) = 0.3 × 0.5 = 0.15. So P(A∪B) = 0.3 + 0.5 - 0.15 = 0.65.

A uniform beam of weight 200 N is pivoted at its centre. A weight of 50 N hangs 2 m from the pivot. Where must a 100 N weight be hung to balance it?
questions.explanation: For equilibrium: clockwise moment = anticlockwise moment. 100 × d = 50 × 2, so d = 100/100 = 1 m from pivot on the other side.
